Police have registered an FIR in connection with alleged graffiti on a police vehicle during the INDIA bloc's November 1 rally at the Ramlila Maidan in Delhi, an official said on Monday (November 2, 2026).
‘Vote chor’ graffiti, littered roads, and a muddy ‘catwalk’ at Ramlila Maidan after INDIA bloc rally
The FIR was registered at Kamla Market police station under sections of the Delhi Prevention of Defacement of Property Act, they said.
According to police, several videos showing graffiti on the police vehicle have gone viral on social media.
